Changes for this game: constant volume adjustments and conversion to 160 kbps
stereo MP3. Playback applies fades and overlaps between tracks. The compositions
are otherwise unedited. This use does not imply the composer's endorsement.
Source download URLs, source/output hashes, durations, and gain adjustments are
recorded in manifest.json alongside these files.

For videos featuring this music, include this attribution in the video description:
Music by Scott Buckley - released under CC-BY 4.0. https://www.scottbuckley.com.au

These tracks are included as part of Hallowmere. The composer's terms prohibit
reselling them in isolation, reuploading them to music streaming platforms, or
registering them with audio fingerprinting services such as Content ID.
